name: Hermès Liu
source:
Hermès is loud, obnoxious, and everything Mimi needs in a comic relief character.

He seems to enjoy watching drama unfold just as much as she does -- sometimes even instigating it himself.

[From [url=http://www.stardust-soda.com/through-the-panels/]official website[/url]]

Born in 1994.
Orientation: Pansexual.
Hometown: Kent, UK.
